recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR core source change is needed unless a future datatype policy intentionally changes code whitespace semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-25413 asked to change the FHIR primitive code regex from using a whitespace metacharacter between tokens to using a literal space, so the regex matches the prose allowing no whitespace other than single spaces.
initial_application: Git commit c4807a5165ee632872ef9f6289fee8e9e1abbb5f, whose message lists FHIR-25413, changed source/datatypes/primitives.xml from [^\s]+(\s[^\s]+)* to [^\s]+( [^\s]+)*.
additional_context: FHIR-37406 later corrected the same regex display in source/datatypes.html. Current datatypes.html now uses the generated [%regex code%] placeholder, and source/fhir.ini routes primitive datatypes to the active datatypes page. A later Questionnaire.item.linkId regex reuse is consistent but governed by separate issues.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because source/datatypes/primitives.xml contains [^\s]+( [^\s]+)* and a repository-wide fixed-string search found no remaining old code regex [^\s]+(\s[^\s]+)*.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue that corrected the stale datatype-table regex display for the same code primitive whitespace rule.
Earlier DSTU1 Published issue about tightening the code regex whitespace pattern; it predates this R4/R5 reconciliation scope.
